name: Woodworking
description: Do you need access to workshop space and tools to complete a woodworking project? Become a member and enjoy 24/7 access to our fully-equipped workshop!

benefits.title: SawStop Tablesaw
benefits.description: Enjoy the safety and convenience of our tablesaw, with an 8' outfeed table, a 52" fence, and the SawStop safety system, which instantly retracts the blade if it contacts skin.

benefits.title: Dust Collection
benefits.description: Breath easy: our workshop is thoughtfully designed, with dust collection ports on each tool and an air filtration system.

benefits.title: CNC Planing
benefits.description: Flatten large wood planks (up to 4' x 8') with our CNC router.*
benefits.footnote: Requires machine training and certification, or assistance from another member who is trained.

benefits.title: Stocked Workbenches
benefits.description: Our woodworking zone includes several large workbenches, each stocked with a variety of hand tools and clamps for your projects.

benefits.title: Glue-up Station
benefits.description: Our dedicated glue-up station is equipped with a large, flat surface and clamps for gluing large projects.
